article.title_es: St. Peter's Church Breakfast Program: comedor en Manhattan

article.summary_es: St. Peter's Church Breakfast Program es un programa de alimentos en Manhattan que aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad. Ofrece desayuno tipo comedor (soup kitchen) los martes por la mañana.
article.summary_en: St. Peter's Church Breakfast Program is a food program in Manhattan listed on the City's Food Help NYC map. It offers a soup kitchen breakfast on Tuesday mornings.
how_they_help_es: Aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC como despensa/comedor de alimentos.
Sirve desayuno tipo comedor (soup kitchen) los martes.
Está ubicado en 619 Lexington Ave, Manhattan, código postal 10022.
Puede llamar al (212) 935-2200 para preguntar antes de ir.
how_they_help_en: Listed on the City's Food Help NYC map as a food pantry/soup kitchen.
Serves a soup kitchen breakfast on Tuesdays.
Located at 619 Lexington Ave, Manhattan, zip code 10022.
You can call (212) 935-2200 to ask questions before going.
visit_tips_es: El horario indicado es martes de 7:15 am a 8 am (soup kitchen).
No se indica qué alimentos se entregan ni si hay requisitos; pregunte por teléfono.
Verifique el horario llamando antes de viajar, ya que puede cambiar.
visit_tips_en: The listed hours are Tuesday 7:15am-8am (soup kitchen).
What food is given and any requirements are not listed; ask by phone.
Confirm the hours by calling before you travel, as they may change.
